new_result.statement: In the joint (A,A) outcome (both triangle-anchored cubic vertices x,y in exact-two-attachment A), rho_x != rho_y is forced. In the one-common-terminal row this is fully rigorous (an unconditional two_cut.md cross-cut-sum argument between two genuine distinct bridges of the same 2-cut {x,z_0}); in the identical-terminal row it follows from the same mechanism conditional on an unproved (but expected) internal-disjointness assumption between the two vertices' external-neighbour branch pieces inside the merged bridge B_2^joint.
